Proposition
[preservation of holomorphic bisectional curvature] Source: cao-zhu 1. Proposition 2.1.5\group Cao–Zhu Preserving Positive Curvature Under the Kähler-Ricci flow if the initial metric has positive $($nonnegative$)$ holomorphic bisectional curvature then the evolved metric also has positive $($nonnegative$)$ holomorphic bisectional curvature.
